policy.scope: bun audit --json (complete lockfile; production reachability reviewed per exception)
policy.rule: Every current advisory must be remediated or exactly matched by one current, owner-bound, evidence-backed exception. Critical advisories are never exceptable.

reachability.rationale: The vulnerable 26.8.1 copy exists only below the optional Windows Squirrel builder toolchain. Command EVE 1.822.0 is built as a macOS arm64 app; its packaged app.asar contains neither app-builder-lib nor electron-builder-squirrel-windows. The active macOS builder is app-builder-lib 26.15.3, which is outside the advisory range. The advisory's AppImage search-path behavior is therefore not present in this release runtime or its macOS build path.

controls: The release pipeline builds only the macOS arm64 target for this artifact.
The packaged app is inspected and must not contain app-builder-lib or electron-builder-squirrel-windows.
The production audit gate remains fail-closed and will reject metadata drift or expiry.
verification: Inspect app.asar package list: app-builder-lib and electron-builder-squirrel-windows have zero hits

remediation.target: Remove the stale 26.8.1 Windows Squirrel peer subtree when electron-builder or Bun resolves the optional peer to 26.15.3 without an incorrect-peer split.
remediation.trigger: Remove this exception when the lockfile no longer contains app-builder-lib 26.8.1, or before producing any Linux AppImage or Windows release from this lockfile.

reachability.rationale: The vulnerable 9.5.1 copy is confined to the optional electron-builder-squirrel-windows 26.8.1 build subtree. The packaged Command EVE app contains builder-util-runtime 9.7.0 exactly, and contains no 9.5.1 copy or Windows Squirrel builder package. Consequently the vulnerable redirect credential handling is absent from the shipped runtime.

controls: Packaged runtime inspection pins builder-util-runtime to 9.7.0.
The vulnerable 9.5.1 subtree is build-only and excluded from app.asar.
The production audit gate remains fail-closed and will reject metadata drift or expiry.

remediation.target: Remove the stale builder-util-runtime 9.5.1 subtree together with the obsolete Windows Squirrel peer split.
remediation.trigger: Remove this exception when the lockfile no longer contains builder-util-runtime 9.5.1, or before changing the packaged updater/runtime dependency graph.

reachability.rationale: The package is transitive through @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0, but Command EVE does not import @hono/node-server or its vulnerable serve-static subpath. Product-owned MCP servers use stdio, and the connector catalog blocks HTTP, SSE and streamable-HTTP transports by default.

controls: The vulnerable serve-static entrypoint is not loaded by Command EVE runtime code.
External HTTP, SSE and streamable-HTTP MCP transports remain blocked by the connector catalog.

The production audit gate re-runs a first-party substring tripwire over packages/** source and fails if a literal '@hono/node-server' specifier appears in product source. This is a tripwire, not a module-graph reachability proof; it intentionally excludes node_modules/resources and cannot see computed specifiers.

remediation.target: A production-supported @modelcontextprotocol/sdk line that resolves @hono/node-server >=2.0.5, or a separately proven v2 adapter upgrade.
remediation.trigger: Remove this exception as soon as the MCP SDK publishes a compatible production dependency range; do not force the current v1 SDK across the @hono/node-server major boundary without its integration suite.
